===Specifications=== :'''Banana Pi BPI-WiFi 6 Mini''' board *CPU: [[TriDuctor]] TR6560 @1.2GHz :Dual-Core ARM (Cortex-A9) *Storage: 512KB (NOR), 128MB (NAND) Flash *Memory: 128MB (DDR3) RAM *WLAN: [[TriDuctor]] TR5220GCF :802.11abgn/ac/ax 2.4/5GHz DBDC *PCIe: 1x M.2 (Key B) USB 3.0 *USB: 1x USB 3.0 port *Network: 2x GbE ports *Power Source: 12V/20W USB (Type-C) PD
